dossier.purpose: Podman is a daemonless OCI container engine (CLI `podman`, core library `libpod/`, REST API, Go bindings) for containers, images, volumes, networks and pods. It runs rootless on Linux, and on macOS/Windows through a Podman-managed Linux VM (`podman machine`) (README.md:15-17,32-42). The repo moved to the podman-container-tools org (module go.podman.io/podman/v6, go.mod:1; RELEASE_NOTES.md:108). Quadlet is the in-repo systemd generator (cmd/quadlet/, pkg/systemd/quadlet/). It turns .container/.pod/.volume/.network/.kube/.build/.image/.artifact unit files into systemd services (docs/source/markdown/podman-systemd.unit.5.md:5-17,52-65), and `podman quadlet install|list|print|rm` manage those files (docs/source/markdown/podman-quadlet.1.md:14-21). Other multi-container paths in the repo: `podman kube play` for Kubernetes YAML (docs/source/markdown/podman-kube-play.1.md.in:4-27) and `podman compose`, a thin wrapper that executes an external docker-compose or podman-compose (docs/source/markdown/podman-compose.1.md.in:9-12). Isolation is container-level (namespaces, cgroups v2, seccomp, capabilities, SELinux/AppArmor); no Landlock, bubblewrap, firejail or seatbelt reference exists outside vendor/ (grep).

claims.claim: Podman is 'a tool for managing containers and images, volumes mounted into those containers, and pods made from groups of containers.'
Runs containers on Linux; on Mac and Windows it uses a Podman-managed virtual machine (`podman machine`).
Major/minor releases 4 times a year (Feb/May/Aug/Nov), patch releases at any time; 'All releases are PGP signed.'
Only the most recent release receives upstream support; the v5.8 series is extended (CVE and critical fixes only) until the 2nd week of June 2027.
Full management of container networking, using Netavark; rootless networking is handled via pasta.
Support for pods, 'groups of containers that share resources and are managed together'.
Support for running containers and pods without root or other elevated privileges.
Resource isolation of containers and pods.
Docker-compatible CLI that can run containers locally and on remote systems.
No manager daemon, for improved security and lower resource utilization at idle.
REST API providing both a Docker-compatible interface and an improved interface exposing advanced Podman functionality.
Rootless: no setuid binary needed; rootless containers 'will never have more privileges than the user that launched them'; an administrator must still do some configuration (subuid/subgid).
Out of scope: specialized image signing/pushing (Skopeo) and the Kubernetes CRI (CRI-O).

Install instructions are not in the README: 'Installation notes' link to install.md; container images are published at quay.io/podman/stable. The README never mentions Quadlet, systemd, compose, WSL or MCP (grep, no matches).

platforms.linux_x86_64: yes. Native Podman is PR-tested on x86_64 Debian and Fedora (SUPPORT.md:25-29); .github/workflows/ci.yml:204-216,342-388 builds and tests fedora-current, fedora-prior, fedora-rawhide and debian-sid in Lima VMs. Quadlet additionally needs systemd (generator plus D-Bus: pkg/domain/infra/abi/quadlet.go:35-40) and cgroup v2 (docs/source/markdown/podman-systemd.unit.5.md:113; cgroup v1 support dropped in 6.0: RELEASE_NOTES.md:103). Linux engine binaries are not attached to GitHub releases (RELEASE_PROCESS.md:182-191).
platforms.wsl2: yes, with a qualifier. The docs cover WSLv2 only as the backend of `podman machine`: a Podman-managed, Fedora-based WSL distro in which systemd is started in a nested PID namespace (docs/tutorials/podman-for-windows.md:13-14; docs/source/markdown/podman-machine-init.1.md.in:27-29; pkg/machine/wsl/declares.go:37-41). CI runs machine e2e for wsl and hyperv (.github/workflows/ci.yml:562-577; SUPPORT.md:35). Using native Podman inside a user-managed WSL2 distro is not documented in the repo and is outside the CI matrix ('best effort', SUPPORT.md:43-45). RELEASE_NOTES.md:36 says containers.conf force_port_listen is required 'when running Podman on WSL'. Quadlet inside the WSL machine is not covered by docs or machine e2e tests (no 'quadlet' reference under pkg/machine).
platforms.macos_arm64: yes (client plus Linux VM, Apple Silicon only). Containers run in a VM via `podman machine` providers libkrun (default) or applehv (pkg/machine/provider/platform_darwin.go:19-35,54-57; docs/source/markdown/podman-machine.1.md:12-15,28-34; pkg/machine/e2e/README.md:69-70). Intel Macs are unsupported since 6.0 (SUPPORT.md:47-49; CONTRIBUTING.md:64). CI runs macos-machine for applehv and libkrun (ci.yml:659-676). The Makefile builds only podman-remote for darwin (Makefile:242-243), and `podman quadlet` returns 'not implemented for the remote Podman client' (pkg/domain/infra/tunnel/quadlet.go:10-30).
platforms.gpu: yes on Linux, unknown on WSL2. `--gpus` supports NVIDIA and AMD via CDI (docs/source/markdown/options/gpus.md:7). libkrun became the macOS default provider for GPU access to AI workloads (contrib/design-docs/podman6hld.md:163-172; pkg/machine/provider/platform_darwin.go:103-112 checks for krunkit). The repo has no documentation of GPU passthrough for the WSL or Hyper-V providers.

integrations.cli: `podman` and `podman-remote` (cmd/podman/main.go; Makefile:60 builds the remote variant with the `remote` tag). Quadlet CLI: `podman quadlet install|list|print|rm` (docs/source/markdown/podman-quadlet.1.md:14-21), local engine only (pkg/domain/infra/tunnel/quadlet.go:10-30). Also `podman kube play|down|generate|apply`, `podman compose` (cmd/podman/compose.go:22-36), `podman machine ...`. The generator binary `quadlet` is invoked by systemd as podman-system-generator / podman-user-generator (Makefile:912-916; cmd/quadlet/main.go:21-27,589-595).
integrations.mcp: none found. Grep for MCP / model context protocol outside vendor/ returns no matches.
integrations.sdk_or_api: REST API via `podman system service` (Unix socket by default, socket-activated by systemd: docs/source/markdown/podman-system-service.1.md:10-29,69-77). The Compat tree is Docker API current 1.44.0 / minimal 1.24.0, and the Libpod tree is current = binary version / minimal 4.0.0 (version/version.go:37-46). Quadlet REST endpoints exist under /libpod/quadlets (pkg/api/server/register_quadlets.go:12-228, built only for non-remote Linux/FreeBSD). Go client bindings at go.podman.io/podman/v6/pkg/bindings (pkg/bindings/README.md:1-10,40-57; docs/CODE_STRUCTURE.md:46-49 calls it a stable API); no Quadlet bindings package found. podman-py is a separate repo (contrib/design-docs/podman6hld.md:154-156).
integrations.claude_code_or_codex: none found as an integration. AGENTS.md is a guide for AI coding assistants helping contributors to Podman itself (AGENTS.md:7,18). LLM_POLICY.md restricts LLM-generated communication and code contributions (LLM_POLICY.md:15-47).

readme.telemetry_and_network: No telemetry, analytics or phone-home code found in Podman's own sources. Grep for telemetry/analytics/sentry etc. outside vendor/ only hits docs. OpenTelemetry modules appear only as indirect deps (go.mod:178-182) and no non-vendor Go file imports them. There are no hard-coded outbound URLs in non-vendor, non-test Go code except an Apple plist DTD (cmd/podman-mac-helper/install.go:27). contrib/design-docs/podman6hld.md:238 cites Podman Desktop telemetry, which is a separate project. Network use is user-driven. Image pulls go to registries from registries.conf (docs/source/markdown/podman-run.1.md.in:59; README.md:198 pulls quay.io/podman/hello). `podman machine init` pulls docker://quay.io/podman/machine-os (vendor/go.podman.io/common/pkg/config/default.go:292; docs/tutorials/podman-for-windows.md:147-148). `podman quadlet install <url>` does a plain http.Get with no integrity check (pkg/domain/infra/abi/quadlet.go:195,255-258). `podman compose` shells out to an external provider with DOCKER_HOST set and prints a notice (cmd/podman/compose.go:190-231). Quadlet-generated units order after network-online.target (pkg/systemd/quadlet/quadlet.go:2279-2296). No project account is required; registries may need `podman login`. Optional macOS podman-mac-helper must run as root to manage /var/run/docker.sock (cmd/podman-mac-helper/main.go:33-51). The API socket grants arbitrary code execution as the service user; TCP without mutual TLS is discouraged (docs/source/markdown/podman-system-service.1.md:69-77).

entry_points.what: `podman` CLI (Cobra). The same source built with the `remote` tag is `podman-remote`; argv[0]=podmansh switches to a restricted-shell mode (main.go:57-71). Engine mode (local abi vs remote tunnel) is selected at startup (main.go:79-120).

Quadlet systemd generator. Installed as libexec/podman/quadlet and symlinked as podman-system-generator and podman-user-generator (Makefile:912-916). Flags -v, -no-kmsg-log, -user, -dryrun, -version (main.go:589-595).

`podman quadlet` subcommands (install.go, list.go, print.go, remove.go) calling the ContainerEngine Quadlet* methods (pkg/domain/infra/abi/quadlet.go; remote stub in pkg/domain/infra/tunnel/quadlet.go).
`podman system service`: REST API server (service_abi*.go, pkg/api/server), optionally socket-activated via contrib/systemd/system/podman.socket.
Rootless port-forwarding helper, installed to libexec/podman/rootlessport (Makefile:910).
macOS-only root helper managing /var/run/docker.sock via launchd (main.go:25-57).
Test-support binary built with `make binaries` on Linux (Makefile:245).
Windows-only helper that edits the PATH registry value for the installer.

code.architecture: Go monorepo (module go.podman.io/podman/v6, go.mod:1). cmd/podman is the Cobra CLI. Commands call ContainerEngine/ImageEngine interfaces (pkg/domain/entities) implemented by pkg/domain/infra/abi (local, direct libpod calls) or pkg/domain/infra/tunnel (remote, via the pkg/bindings HTTP client) (docs/CODE_STRUCTURE.md:55-66). libpod/ (Linux/FreeBSD only) is the runtime: containers, pods, volumes, SQLite state db.sql (libpod/sqlite_state.go:34), conmon plus OCI runtime execution (libpod/oci_conmon*.go), netavark/pasta networking (libpod/networking_*.go). pkg/api/ is the REST server with Docker-compat and libpod trees (pkg/api/server/register_*.go). Quadlet: cmd/quadlet/main.go (generator loop at lines 441-587), pkg/systemd/quadlet/ (quadlet.go converts Container/Pod/Volume/Network/Kube/Image/Build/Artifact groups to Service units; unitdirs.go holds root/rootless search paths; quadlet_common.go lists extensions), pkg/systemd/parser/ (unit-file parser), pkg/domain/infra/abi/quadlet.go (install/list/rm), pkg/api/handlers/libpod/quadlets.go (REST). Also pkg/machine/ (VM providers qemu/applehv/libkrun/wsl/hyperv; selection in pkg/machine/provider/), pkg/specgen/, pkg/rootless/ (Go+C), vendor/ (go.podman.io/buildah, common, image, storage), and contrib/systemd/system/ (podman.service/socket, podman-kube@.service.in:11-12).
code.packaging_and_release: Release workflow .github/workflows/release.yml triggers on any pushed tag (lines 3-6), rejects -dev versions (45-49), and calls release-build-artifacts.yml. That workflow runs `make release-artifacts` (release-build-artifacts.yml:92-94; Makefile:1041-1054) to produce podman-remote zips for darwin_arm64, windows_amd64 and windows_arm64 plus podman-remote-static-linux_{amd64,arm64}.tar.gz. A macOS arm64 .pkg is built, codesigned and notarized (release-build-artifacts.yml:101-151), and Windows MSIs (amd64, arm64) are built with WiX and signed with AzureSignTool (153-250). release.yml then writes `sha256sum * > shasums` (134-136), runs `gh release create` with notes from RELEASE_NOTES.md (108-120,158-164), emails the mailing list (166-212) and opens a podman.io PR (214-225). Artifact list: RELEASE_PROCESS.md:182-191. No detached signature, cosign, SBOM or provenance-attestation step exists under .github/ (grep). Git tags are meant to be GPG-signed by the releaser (`git tag -s`, RELEASE_PROCESS.md:156,168-169); the tag signature was not inspected. All GitHub Actions are pinned by commit SHA and linted by a zizmor workflow (.github/workflows/zizmor.yml). A daily cron builds the release artifacts to validate the pipeline (release-pipeline-validation.yml:2-6). Linux distribution is via distro packages: rpm/podman.spec (subpackages docker, tests, remote, podmansh, machine: lines 125-191) and Packit to COPR/Koji/Bodhi (.packit.yaml:51-197). machine-os VM images are released from a separate repo in lock-step (RELEASE_PROCESS.md:148-162).
code.tests_and_ci: Frameworks: Go testing for unit tests (`make localunit`, Makefile:673); Ginkgo v2 e2e in test/e2e (142 *_test.go files); BATS system tests in test/system (77 .bats files, plus test/upgrade and test/farm); apiv2 shell tests in test/apiv2 (26 .at files) and pytest in test/apiv2/python and test/python (12 files); compose scenarios in test/compose (13 dirs); machine e2e in pkg/machine/e2e (about 45 files); bindings tests in pkg/bindings/test. Approximate totals: about 335 Go *_test.go files outside vendor (142 test/e2e, 153 pkg/, 21 libpod/, 16 cmd+internal+hack, 4 test/utils). Quadlet coverage: cmd/quadlet/main_test.go, pkg/systemd/quadlet/unitdirs_test.go, pkg/domain/infra/abi/quadlet_utils_test.go, test/e2e/quadlet_test.go with about 310 fixture files in test/e2e/quadlet/, test/system/252-quadlet.bats, 253-podman-quadlet.bats, 254-podman-quadlet-multi.bats, test/apiv2/36-quadlets.at. The Quadlet system tests skip remote mode (252-quadlet.bats:22; 254-podman-quadlet-multi.bats:10). CI is .github/workflows/ci.yml. path-filter; validate-source (golangci-lint, pre-commit, vendor/bindings/swagger cleanliness, tests-included gate, per-commit build with a 50 KiB binary-growth cap: hack/ci/make-and-check-size.sh:38); cross build; build on fedora-current/prior/rawhide and debian-sid via lima.yml; Windows installer builds for hyperv and wsl; macOS installer build; big-tests (sys and int x root/rootless x local/remote x 4 distros); small-tests (apiv2, bindings, compose_v2, docker_py, unit, upgrade from v5.3.1 and v5.6.2); machine-linux (QEMU); windows-unit, windows-e2e, windows-machine (hyperv, wsl); macos-machine (applehv, libkrun); a 'Total Success' gate. Other workflows: release.yml, release-build-artifacts.yml, release-pipeline-validation.yml, zizmor.yml, machine-os-pr.yml, update-podmanio.yml, dev-bump.yml, cherry-pick.yml, and labeler/stale/lock/assign bots. The test jobs run on x86 runners; the arm64 machine runner is commented out (ci.yml:444-447).
code.dependencies: go.mod: 73 direct requires (lines 9-81) and 108 indirect (85-192), vendored in vendor/ (vendor/modules.txt), including go.podman.io/buildah v1.45.1, common v0.69.2, image/v5 v5.41.2 and storage v1.64.1 (go.mod:67-70). test/tools/go.mod: 2 direct (go-md2man, go-swagger) and 62 indirect. test/apiv2/python/requirements.txt: 8 entries. docs/requirements.txt: 1 (myst_parser). pyproject.toml holds only black config. Build-time native: CGO_ENABLED=1 (Makefile:28-30), libseccomp, libsystemd, gpgme, btrfs, assuan headers (Makefile:61-68; ci.yml:76-89). Runtime: crun (the only runtime supported upstream), conmon, catatonit, netavark plus aardvark-dns, passt/pasta for rootless (DISTRO_PACKAGE.md:28-98). Rootless also needs /etc/subuid and /etc/subgid (docs/tutorials/rootless_tutorial.md:30-34). Quadlet needs systemd and cgroup v2. VM features need gvproxy plus qemu (Linux), vfkit/krunkit (macOS), WSL or Hyper-V (Windows).
code.security_policy: SECURITY.md (3 lines) defers to the Containers Projects policy at github.com/containers/container-libs/blob/main/SECURITY.md (external, not opened). README.md:50-51 says report privately to security@lists.podman.io, and CONTRIBUTING.md:46 links the container-libs SECURITY.md under the podman-container-tools org. docs/cncf/self-assessment.md is project-written and marked 'Assessment Stage: Incomplete' (line 22), 'not intended to provide a security audit' (line 128). Release notes reference GitHub security advisories (RELEASE_NOTES.md:5,12-13,23,96).

claim_checks.evidence: cmd/podman/main.go:73-75 runs the CLI in-process, and local mode calls libpod through pkg/domain/infra/abi (docs/CODE_STRUCTURE.md:62-66). The REST service is optional and socket-activated (docs/source/markdown/podman-system-service.1.md:10-29). Helper processes still exist: conmon per container and a catatonit pause process (DISTRO_PACKAGE.md:56-70); Quadlet containers are supervised by systemd units.

claim_checks.claim: Pods of containers that share resources (README.md:36)
claim_checks.evidence: Quadlet .pod units are generated by ConvertPod with Type=forking and Restart=on-failure by default (pkg/systemd/quadlet/quadlet.go:1606-1717). Containers join with Pod=<name>.pod and get BindsTo/After on the pod service (quadlet.go:2214-2240). `podman kube play` also creates pods (docs/source/markdown/podman-kube-play.1.md.in:10).

claim_checks.claim: Networking via Netavark; rootless via pasta (README.md:35,109)
claim_checks.evidence: libpod/networking_linux.go:65-69 and libpod/networking_common.go:135 delegate to netavark Setup/Teardown. CNI and slirp4netns support were removed in 6.0 (RELEASE_NOTES.md:105-106). pasta is the rootless default and bridge the rootful default (docs/source/markdown/options/network.md:28,55-61).

claim_checks.claim: Run containers and pods without root (README.md:37,78-87)
claim_checks.evidence: Works, but needs admin preparation: /etc/subuid and /etc/subgid plus a user-mode network tool (docs/tutorials/rootless_tutorial.md:19-34). Documented limits: ports below 1024, NFS home dirs, 65536-UID range, no CRIU checkpoint (rootless.md:5-35). Quadlet has rootless search paths and a per-user install dir (pkg/systemd/quadlet/unitdirs.go:26-36,226-253).

claim_checks.claim: Resource isolation of containers and pods (README.md:38)
claim_checks.evidence: Containers get namespaces and cgroups, an 11-capability default set (vendor/go.podman.io/common/pkg/config/default.go:104-117) and masked /proc paths (docs/source/markdown/options/security-opt.md:34). Defaults are not deny-by-default: networking is on (bridge for root, pasta for rootless: options/network.md:28,53-61) and the root filesystem is writable (options/read-only.md:13). Restrictions are opt-in: `--network none` (network.md:45), `--read-only`, `:ro` volumes (options/volume.md:70), `network create --internal` (options/internal.md:11-25), Quadlet `Internal=` (pkg/systemd/quadlet/quadlet.go:1037-1042), Quadlet NoNewPrivileges and ReadOnly default to false (docs/source/markdown/podman-systemd.unit.5.md:809,876).

claim_checks.claim: REST API with Docker-compatible and improved interfaces (README.md:41)
claim_checks.evidence: version/version.go:37-46 defines a Compat tree (current 1.44.0, minimal 1.24.0) and a Libpod tree (current = binary version, minimal 4.0.0). docs/source/markdown/podman-system-service.1.md:15 still says Docker v1.40; the code differs, and code is preferred.

claim_checks.claim: Mac and Windows supported via `podman machine` (README.md:16,42)
claim_checks.evidence: Providers: Linux qemu, macOS libkrun (default) and applehv, Windows wsl (default) and hyperv (docs/source/markdown/podman-machine.1.md:28-34; pkg/machine/provider/platform_darwin.go, platform_windows.go, platform_unix.go). Intel Macs and Windows 10 are dropped (SUPPORT.md:47-49). Docs say the default machine mount is $HOME:$HOME (docs/source/markdown/podman-machine-init.1.md.in:199-200), but macOS code defaults to /Users, /private and /var/folders (vendor/go.podman.io/common/pkg/config/default_darwin.go:16-22), plus the host config dir mounted at /etc/containers (default.go:282-287); code is preferred.

RELEASE_PROCESS.md:156,168-169 calls for signed git tags (`git tag -s`), but the tag signature was not inspected here. The release workflow publishes artifacts plus a plain `shasums` file (.github/workflows/release.yml:134-136,158-164) with no detached .asc, cosign, SBOM or provenance step under .github/ (grep). The macOS pkg is codesigned and notarized (release-build-artifacts.yml:142-145) and Windows MSIs are signed via AzureSignTool (197-210). RELEASE_PROCESS.md:184-185 lists Windows .exe installers while the workflow builds .msi (release-build-artifacts.yml:243).

claim_checks.claim: Quadlet turns unit files into a multi-service app on systemd (AGENTS.md:18; man page podman-systemd.unit.5.md:5-17). The README is silent on Quadlet.
claim_checks.evidence: cmd/quadlet/main.go:529-559 converts .container, .volume, .kube, .network, .image, .build, .artifact and .pod files; extensions are listed in pkg/systemd/quadlet/quadlet_common.go:5-14. Network=, Volume=, Image=, Pod= references add Requires=/After= on the referenced unit's service (quadlet.go:1848-1892,1955-1984,2214-2240). Resource names get a systemd- prefix (quadlet.go:953-977), and units wait on network-online.target (2279-2296). Limits: `podman quadlet install|list|print|rm` is not implemented for the remote client (pkg/domain/infra/tunnel/quadlet.go:10-30) and install requires a systemd D-Bus connection (pkg/domain/infra/abi/quadlet.go:35-40). `podman generate systemd` is deprecated in favor of Quadlet (docs/source/markdown/podman-generate-systemd.1.md:10-12).

claim_checks.claim: `podman quadlet install` accepts 'local files, Web URLs, and OCI artifacts' (cmd/podman/quadlet/install.go:15)
claim_checks.evidence: The man page lists only local files or URLs (docs/source/markdown/podman-quadlet-install.1.md.in:11). The abi code accepts local paths and directories, http(s) URLs only (isURL, pkg/domain/infra/abi/quadlet.go:255-258) and multi-document .quadlets files split on '---' with a required '# FileName=' comment (abi/quadlet.go:388-480). No OCI-artifact source handling was found in that file; code is preferred. URL downloads use http.Get without hash or signature checks (abi/quadlet.go:195).

benchmarks.what: `podman machine start` mean startup time, WSL provider, no CA import (import via mount adds 3.9 s, via scp adds 5.1 s)
benchmarks.source: contrib/design-docs/import-ca-certs.md:119-125 (measured with a patched client by a project maintainer; raw data in an external gist, not opened)

benchmarks.what: `podman machine start` mean startup time, Hyper-V provider, no CA import (mnt adds 3.4 s, scp adds 4.7 s)
`podman machine start` mean startup time, applehv provider, no CA import (mnt adds 1.4 s, scp adds 1.6 s)
`podman machine start` mean startup time, libkrun provider, no CA import (mnt adds 1.3 s, scp adds 1.4 s)

risks: Quadlet is Linux/systemd-only and its management CLI is local-only. `podman quadlet install|list|print|rm` return 'not implemented for the remote Podman client' (pkg/domain/infra/tunnel/quadlet.go:10-30; test/system/254-podman-quadlet-multi.bats:10 skips remote). Install requires a systemd D-Bus session plus the quadlet helper (pkg/domain/infra/abi/quadlet.go:35-60). `quadlet` is not built for darwin/windows/freebsd targets (Makefile:239-246,909-919). On macOS/Windows Quadlets would have to live inside the machine VM; no repo doc and no machine e2e test (no 'quadlet' reference under pkg/machine) covers that. Some systemd [Service] options such as PrivateNetwork do not work in rootless units (rootless.md:17-18).

Platform coverage gaps. WSL2 is documented and tested only as the Podman-managed `podman machine` backend; a user-managed WSL2 distro is 'best effort' (SUPPORT.md:43-45). SUPPORT.md:35 names Windows 2022 while CI runs windows-2025-vs2026 (ci.yml:571), and SUPPORT.md:29 lists ARM64 Fedora while ci.yml shows only x86 runners (arm64 machine runner commented out, ci.yml:444-447). RELEASE_NOTES.md:36 says force_port_listen is required on WSL, but no code setting it for WSL machines exists in this repo (only libpod/networking_common.go:31 and a system test). The WSL kernel lacks some modules (pkg/machine/wsl/declares.go:93-96).

Isolation defaults are permissive and opt-in, not deny-by-default: networking is on (bridge or pasta), the root filesystem is writable, 11 default capabilities, Quadlet NoNewPrivileges/ReadOnly default false (see claim_checks). Podman provides container-level isolation only; no Landlock, bubblewrap, firejail or seatbelt code or docs exist outside vendor/ (grep). The docs state the API socket grants arbitrary code execution as the service user (docs/source/markdown/podman-system-service.1.md:69-71).

Recent sandbox-relevant security fixes. v6.1.3 fixes CVE-2026-94603: `podman run` on a checkpoint image could disable all sandboxing, including user-specified sandboxing; checkpoint-image support in `podman run` was removed (RELEASE_NOTES.md:5-8). v6.1.2 fixes host file overwrite via `podman load` / `volume import` (CVE-2025-11395, RELEASE_NOTES.md:12). v6.0.0 fixes host environment leakage into containers (CVE-2026-57231, RELEASE_NOTES.md:96). The security self-assessment is written by the project and marked 'Incomplete' (docs/cncf/self-assessment.md:22,128).

On VM platforms the host-filesystem boundary is wider than a per-container one. macOS machines mount /Users, /private and /var/folders by default (vendor/go.podman.io/common/pkg/config/default_darwin.go:16-22; the docs say $HOME:$HOME). The host user config dir is mounted at /etc/containers (default.go:282-287; WSL bind-mounts it: pkg/machine/wsl/declares.go:98-109). WSL mounts all Windows drives under /mnt (docs/source/markdown/podman-machine-init.1.md.in:202-205). Machine mounts default to read-write (podman-machine-init.1.md.in:169-171).

Release integrity and distribution. README.md:19 says all releases are PGP signed, but release assets are unsigned artifacts plus an in-workflow `shasums` file, with no attestations or SBOM (.github/workflows/release.yml:134-136; grep of .github/). No Linux engine binary is published on the release page, only podman-remote static tarballs, the macOS arm64 pkg, Windows MSIs and zips (RELEASE_PROCESS.md:182-191), so Linux installs depend on distro packages (DOWNLOADS.md:7-11) or source builds. The macOS pkg build downloads vfkit, krunkit and gvproxy by version with curl and no checksum (contrib/pkginstaller/Makefile:28,32,36).

Maintenance and stability. Only the latest release has upstream support; 5.8 is extended to June 2027 (README.md:21). 6.0 shipped many breaking changes: BoltDB to SQLite migration, removal of cgroups v1, CNI, slirp4netns and iptables, a new Quadlet install layout, and dropped Intel Mac and Windows 10 (RELEASE_NOTES.md:98-121). 19 of the 21 listed maintainers/reviewers are affiliated with one vendor (MAINTAINERS.md:13-33). The org move is still visible in docs: README badges and the spec Source0 still reference containers/podman (README.md:4-10; rpm/podman.spec:74).

Scope and licensing. No single Podman command covers 'multi-service app': Quadlet (systemd services, Linux only), `podman kube play` (Kubernetes subset: Pod, Deployment, PersistentVolumeClaim, ConfigMap, Secret, DaemonSet, Job; docs/source/markdown/podman-kube-play.1.md.in:19-27) and `podman compose` (needs an external provider, podman-compose.1.md.in:9-12) are separate paths with different semantics. Install guidance and the security reporting policy live outside this repo (install.md:3; SECURITY.md:3). The repo license is Apache-2.0 (LICENSE:1-3); the RPM spec lists Apache-2.0 AND BSD-2-Clause AND BSD-3-Clause AND ISC AND MIT AND MPL-2.0 for the combined vendored work (rpm/podman.spec:64).
